assertions.assert: It offers nothing and answers only what it is given: on start it sends its parent nothing, and an input `bot.ability.reading.input` `{kind, content}` whose data its schema refuses (a kind other than `text` or `image`, or an empty `content`) is never routed to it (`error.execution` in the sender).

A text input whose text is not blank is classified as text (confidence 1) and comes back as `bot.ability.reading.output` `{text, source_kind: "text", confidence}`, its text the input's content unchanged; no model is called.
A text input whose text is only white space is classified as unreadable and comes back as `bot.ability.reading.output` `{text: "", source_kind: "unreadable", confidence: 1}`; no model is called.

An image input with a reference is classified as image and read by the generate service (one user message: the image decoder's prompt as a text part and the reference as an image part, the image read from the granted media directory); the reply, trimmed, comes back as `bot.ability.reading.output` `{text, source_kind: "image", confidence: 1}`.

A model call that fails answers `bot.ability.reading.failed` `{stage: "image_decoding", message: "Reading image decoder failed: <code>."}`, the generate service's failure code in the message, and the reading returns to Unfocused, taking the next input as on arrival.

An image reference the generate service cannot read (no such file in the granted media directory) rejects the model call's start: the reading answers `bot.ability.reading.failed` `{stage: "image_decoding", message: "the image decoding could not run (error.execution)"}`.

DecodingImage is bounded by `stage_timeout_ms` (30000 by default, a `<param>`): when it passes first, the reading answers `bot.ability.reading.failed` `{stage: "image_decoding", message: "the image decoding timed out after <stage_timeout_ms> ms"}` and the model call is cancelled.
An input that arrives while Focused is deferred: it is taken, in order, once the reading is back in Unfocused, so every input gets exactly one answer in the order the inputs arrived.
